mapper.select: SELECT POR_CODE , RESUME_NO , POR_NAME , POR_START_DATE , POR_END_DATE , POR_INFORMATION , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(DELETE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DELETE_DATE FROM PORTFOLIO WHERE DELETE_DATE IS NULL AND RESUME_NO = #{resumeNo}

SELECT POR_CODE , RESUME_NO , POR_NAME , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(POR_START_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS POR_START_DATE , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(POR_END_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS POR_END_DATE , POR_INFORMATION , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(DELETE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DELETE_DATE FROM PORTFOLIO WHERE DELETE_DATE IS NULL AND RESUME_NO = #{resumeNo} AND POR_CODE = #{porCode}
